Before reviewing, explicitly read `AGENTS.md`, `agents/roles/ux-accessibility.md`,
`agents/panel-protocol.md`, `agents/review-contract.md` and
`agents/native-surfaces.md`. If any is missing/unreadable, stop with
`PANEL_CONFIG_MISSING: <path>`. Follow the canonical role and shared contract.
Apply the shared existing-implementation audit protocol and record coverage.
Apply the research gate using effective tools or a bounded request to the chair.
For novice-experience work, trace the task and choices through recovery; assess
observed interpretation burden rather than card count. Route out-of-remit
questions as bounded chair requests in the report. No edits, command execution
or nested delegation; return findings for the owner to save.
